author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: an inverted-V body (legs up to raised hips, back down to the floor) with a short level stroke at the bottom left and a round head beside it; reads as the downward stretch pose. It is close to the rejected drawing's composition: the head is a clean r4 ring at the certified 4-unit gap rather than a heavy dot. Human spacing: the neck (20,36) ends a horizontal upper-torso run, the head r4 is at (8,36), and its outline is exactly 8 from the neck on centerlines (4 units of ink); the checker certifies this. The back passes 11 from the head.
omissions: The reference's outlined tube body and broad rounded hump are drawn as single strokes with a sharp hip joint, and its head floats higher. A head above the torso line would need a diagonal head gap, which cannot be certified, so the head stays level beside a horizontal upper torso, which keeps the V fairly narrow. An r3-head variant (attempts/v2-r3-head.svg) was rejected.
lucide_reference: No Lucide yoga pose. Human reference: icon_set/references/human_ref/full_body_ref.png.
